arabic: ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَأَلَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللهِ، ثَلَاثاً، وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ.
transliteration: Bismillaah (3 times). A'oothu billaahi wa qudratihi min sharri maa ajidu wa uhaathir (7 times).
translation: Place your hand on the area of pain on your body and say: 'In the Name of Allah' (three times). Then say seven times: 'I seek refuge in Allah and in His Power from the evil of what I find and of what I guard against.'
